summary: News Corporation filed a Form 8-K on September 23, 2026 (filed September 24, 2026) under Items 8.01 and 9.01, furnishing daily ASX disclosures tied to its existing $1 billion stock repurchase program. The registrant acts as issuer, repurchasing Class A (NWSA) and Class B (NWS) common stock from time to time. No price per share, stake percentage, premium, advisors, or board recommendation appear in the excerpt. The filing is purely disclosure-related, with no new authorization amount disclosed; mechanics remain open-market purchases subject to market conditions and securities laws. Watch repurchase pace and any new authorization as signals of management capital-allocation conviction.
